title: Pure Cyber Angel
summary: Pure Cyber Angel LIGHT Fairy Ritual build featuring Alexis Rhodes' full Ritual lineup and the 2019 Machine Angel support wave, paired with generic staples and an automatic Extra Deck. Cyber Angel Benten and Cyber Angel Idaten generate searches and permanent ATK buffs when Tributed for Ritual Summons, setting up Cyber Angel Dakini, Izana, Vrash, and Natasha.

summary.title: Starters
points: Cyber Petit Angel searches any Cyber Angel monster or Machine Angel Ritual from the Deck when Normal, Flip, or Special Summoned.

Cyber Egg Angel searches any Machine Angel Spell (Machine Angel Ritual, Machine Angel Absolute Ritual, Merciful Machine Angel, Incarnated Machine Angel, or Magnificent Machine Angel) on Normal, Flip, or Special Summon.

Cyber Angel Benten (Level 6) adds any LIGHT Fairy monster from the Deck to your hand whenever it is Tributed (with no once-per-turn limit), and Cyber Angel Idaten (Level 6) searches or recovers a Ritual Spell on Ritual Summon and permanently boosts all your Ritual Monsters by 1000 ATK/DEF when Tributed.

summary.title: Opening: Cyber Petit Angel + Benten / Ritual Spell
steps: Normal Summon Cyber Petit Angel (or Cyber Egg Angel) to search the missing piece of Machine Angel Ritual, Cyber Angel Benten, or Cyber Angel Idaten.

Activate Machine Angel Ritual, Tributing Cyber Angel Benten from the hand to Ritual Summon Cyber Angel Idaten; Benten searches Cyber Angel Dakini (or Izana), and Idaten adds Machine Angel Absolute Ritual from the Deck.
Activate Machine Angel Absolute Ritual, Tributing Idaten (or shuffling Benten from the GY into the Deck) to Ritual Summon Cyber Angel Dakini with +1000 ATK/DEF from Idaten.

summary.title: Ritual Bosses
points: Cyber Angel Dakini (Level 8) forces the opponent to send 1 monster they control to the GY on Ritual Summon (bypassing targeting and destruction immunity), grants piercing damage to all your Ritual Monsters, and recovers a Ritual Monster or Machine Angel Ritual every End Phase.

Cyber Angel Izana (Level 8) forces the opponent to send 1 Spell/Trap they control to the GY on Ritual Summon, makes a second monster attack after destroying a monster by battle, and shuffles a Ritual Spell from the GY into the Deck to negate an opponent's targeting effect and destroy 1 card.

Cyber Angel Vrash (Level 10) destroys all opponent's monsters Special Summoned from the Extra Deck on Ritual Summon (burning 1000 each and attacking twice), and Cyber Angel Natasha (Level 5) gains LP, negates attacks, and banishes a Cyber Angel from the GY to revive itself and steal an opponent's monster.

summary.title: Machine Angel Spells
points: Machine Angel Ritual Ritual Summons any Cyber Angel and can banish itself from the GY when a LIGHT monster you control would be destroyed by battle or card effect instead.
Machine Angel Absolute Ritual requires exact Levels and can shuffle Fairy or Warrior monsters from the GY into the Deck as Tributes.

Merciful Machine Angel Tributes a Cyber Angel from hand or field to draw 2 cards and place 1 card on the bottom of the Deck (locking you to Ritual Monsters for the rest of the turn), Magnificent Machine Angel Tributes a Cyber Angel to boost a LIGHT Fairy by 200 times its Level and negate Extra Deck monster effects in battle, and Incarnated Machine Angel prevents battle destruction and Tributes a Cyber Angel on damage to Special Summon another from the hand as a Ritual Summon.
